name: microsite-refresh
description: Refresh Champions Group data-list microsites into 2027-ready landing pages: a signature hero worked out with the owner, purpose-first navigation (any list in two clicks), a drop-a-file verification hero, human writing with no AI slop, visual QA and agent readiness for AI crawlers and browser agents. Includes the SPAN campaign landing-page builder with count-backed and count-free examples, plus scroll-craft and human-speak by Nate Herk (MIT).
